input: Any commit that modifies /moves/rook_h8.text or /moves/rook_a8.text or /moves/pawn_a7.text (the agents that have gone off plan) must be signed by that moving piece and co-signed by at least fifteen of the sixteen Black agents, including queen_d8.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_h8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_a8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_a7.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/pawn_a7.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_a7.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/pawn_a7.text) -threshold("15", /team/pieces)] false))
